rows.en:
"Senpai... Huh?"
{a} isn't here yet.
Honestly, and it's already the time we agreed on.
Really... Hm?{p}

What's this notebook?
'Notebook of Grudges'
.........?
Whose notebook is this, I wonder?
Oh, I'll just take a peek.
"Mayumi Taguchi: looked at me funny."
...That's {a}'s handwriting.
What a weirdo.
Keeping a notebook like this.
"Hey, Taguchi."
Oh, {a}...
"Senpai, what is this notebook?!"
"...Oh, you saw that?"
Senpai's expression changed.
"...Well, it's the truth, isn't it? You're always looking at me funny."{p}
...Oh, he's sulking.
He's kind of cute, maybe
Ewww, creepy

He's kind of cute, maybe.
Senpai has his annoying side, but sometimes he does cute things.
Actually, I don't dislike him all that much.
Sometimes I think he's kind of fun, too.
"Taguchi. Give me back the notebook."
Okay, okay, I'll give it back.{p}

"...So, shall we talk?
You know how our school is building a second gym right now?"
...Oh, right, it is.
"To commemorate it, I want to do a feature on the school's seven wonders."
Seven wonders?
...{a} looks kind of happy.
His whole face has gone slack.
His voice has gone all squeaky, too.
"Taguchi, are you listening?"
Oops.
"I'm listening. It's about the second gym, right?"{p}

...Right, about the second gym.
There used to be an old school building on that spot.
It was torn down two summers ago.
It was a really creepy building.
The wooden walls and floors were rotting in places.
The whole place reeked of mildew.
And on top of that, there were tons of supernatural phenomena.
All sorts of people had terrifying experiences there.
Taguchi.
About that old school building...{p}
You'll listen, won't you?

Hmm.
No, I'll turn him down after all.
He's weird, and mean on top of that.
He's always pushing nasty interviews onto people.
Apparently the same thing was done to {a} as a first-year.
So it seems he thinks it's his turn to bully the juniors now.
How petty.
Senpai said he'd be waiting in the club room.
Oh well.
I'll go and tell him no.{p}

"{a}!
I'm so sorry...!"
"Hey, Taguchi."
"Um, actually, I..."
"Sorry for calling you all the way out here.
Well, have a seat.
Say, you know the second gym is almost finished, right?"{p}

...Hold on a minute.
I didn't come here to chat with you, Senpai.
"So, Taguchi.
To celebrate the second gym's completion, I want to do a feature on the school's seven wonders."
"Huh, the school's seven wonders?"
...Ugh, I blew it.
I had no intention of listening to him, but I answered without thinking.
"Taguchi.
Do you know what used to be there before the second gym was built?"{p}

...I've heard about it.
I think what used to be there was...
Ugh, no, no.
I mustn't listen to anything {a} says.
..........
But...{p}

Doesn't it sound kind of interesting?
Maybe I could play along a little.
He might even get around to saying he wants to make me club president someday.
Umm.
I think what stood there before the second gym was...
"Don't know? It was the old school building."
Oh, right, it was the old school building.
"The old school building was torn down two summers ago.
That place had tons of supernatural phenomena, but..."
{a} is telling it so smugly.
It's kind of making me laugh.
"Taguchi, what's so funny?"
"Oh, n-nothing..."{p}

...Taguchi.
This is no laughing matter.
This is serious.
When they tore down the old school building, they turned up.
Skeletons, heaps of them...
That started all sorts of rumors.
That there was an air-raid shelter under the old school building, or that lots of war dead were buried around there.
...And then there was this, too.{p}

Ewww, creepy.
Ugh, the worst.
{a} really is weird.
Keeping a notebook like this is way too gloomy for me.
"Taguchi, would you mind giving that notebook back?"
Fine, fine, I'll give it back, okay?{p}

Seriously, why is someone like him the club president?
Maybe I'm just not cut out for the newspaper club, like everyone says.
Senpai took the notebook and slowly began reading it aloud.
"I will now read the charges against Mayumi Taguchi."
Wait a second, what charges against me?!
Even as a joke, this is going way too far. It's like a trial!
But Senpai has a dead serious look on his face.
Is he really planning to put me on trial?{p}

"Mayumi Taguchi: looked at me funny.
Ignored me when I spoke to her.
Slacked off cleaning the restrooms.
Ate the last cookie.
Called the fortune I kindly told her a fake.
...That is all."
It's like an elementary school class meeting.
I'm really starting to feel uneasy about this guy being club president.{p}

"...I shall now pronounce the sentence. Mayumi Taguchi, for these crimes, you are sentenced to death☆"
No way☆
A death sentence for something this small? That's absurd!
I refuse to accept a trial with no jury and no defense lawyer!
"This verdict is the will of every member of the Murder Club, and {b} {a} shall carry out the sentence in the name of its second president."{p}

"Um... how many people is 'every member'?"
I asked timidly.
I mean, I don't want to think that so many people hold a grudge against me.
"One member in total."
"So that means it's just you, Senpai?"
"You're so annoying. Only the elite of the elite may join this club. There can't be that many geniuses around, can there?"{p}

What a convenient answer.
It sounds cool when he puts it that way, but in the end doesn't that just mean he has no friends and nobody pays any attention to him?
"Well, let's see. I'm not a monster, after all.
I'll give you just one chance.
If you join the Murder Club and work for me, I might call off your execution.
What do you say? Surely there's a person or two you'd like to kill, too?"
He wants me to join him?
He seems to mean it, but...{p}What should I do?
Tell him I'll join
Tell him I'd never join him, even if it killed me

"I wouldn't join you even if it killed me.
I absolutely refuse."
Honestly, this is no joke.
"Is that so? What a pity."{p}

At that moment, a sharp pain shot through my back.
Something clattered and rolled at my feet.
It was a blood-soaked ice pick.
So I'd been stabbed with this.
But by who...?{p}

Senpai was right in front of me and hadn't moved a single step.
And nobody had come in or gone out the whole time, so does that mean someone besides {a} had been hiding in this room from the start...?{p}

"What's the matter?
You look pale.
You seem to be suffering. I don't think you'll make it.
If you were a friend, I'd put you out of your misery in one go, but you turned me down.
Do savor the pain to the very end.
Well then, I'll be taking my leave first."
With that, Senpai stood up from his chair and looked down at me.
My body was already numb; I couldn't even move my arms or legs.
"I... was... stab... bed?"
Seeing me unable to even make a sound anymore, Senpai smiled with delight.
"Oh, that's right. The ghosts of the previous Murder Club members haunt this club room, so you'd better be careful. They all lost their battles with me and died. Not that I killed them, mind you. ...What? They must hate me? No, no, they're all precious comrades who do exactly as I say. When I tell them to kill someone, they kill, and when I told them to stab you in the back with an ice pick, they did it properly, didn't they? Oh my, it seems you can't hear me anymore. Well then, I'll leave the door unlocked, so you can go home whenever you like. Not that it matters if your body is found here; I can deal with that one way or another."{p}

I think he's a weird person.
I mean, sometimes he tells awful jokes.
Like that he's been to planet Sunbararia, or that Sanbura tea tastes grassy...
He seems like someone with dangerous ideas.
So right now I'm a bit torn.{p}What should I do...?
Go
Don't go

Actually, I'm a little curious.
They say there was once a boy at our school who never went to the toilet.
Apparently {a} knows that person's secret.
I'd love to hear it.
Romantic girls dream of living a life like that.
Just kidding.
Actually, it's plain curiosity.
Even if he says it's a super important talk...
Knowing {a}, he's bound to come out with some huge goof.
Afterward I'll spread it around and have a good laugh.
And besides, I heard a rumor.
That {a} used to go out with an older woman.
She was a student at this school.
Her name was... Iwa... Iwashita something.
Was it Creepymi Iwashita?
No... maybe it was Creepemi.{p}

...Oh well, whatever.
Apparently {a} went out with her and she nearly killed him.
She was supposedly an incredibly jealous person.
I told {a} a while ago that I wanted to write an article about it.{p}

Maybe that's what he called me here for today.
That'd be fun.
I can't wait...
Hee hee.{p}
...Okay, here's the club room.{p}

"Senpai☆"
"Wh-whoa!☆"
"Eek..."
Senpai fell right off his chair.
My loud voice must have startled him.
How pathetic.
He really is weird.
"Oh, I'm sorry..."
I apologized, at least.
Though inside, I could barely keep from laughing.
"Geez, you scared me.
I thought the Deberondattans had launched a counterattack."{p}

..........
This guy really is weird.
"Um, {a}, what did you want to talk about?"
I'll hear it quickly and say bye-bye.
"Oh, sorry. The thing is...
You know the second gym is almost finished, right?
To celebrate it, I want to do a feature on the school's seven wonders."
"Huh, the school's seven wonders?"{p}

Wh-what...?
{a}'s eyes look like they're glowing gold...
No way.
"{a}, um..."{p}

...Taguchi, just be quiet and listen.
When they tore down the old school building, there was a huge uproar.
Even TV stations came to report on it.
Haven't you heard?
The story about masses of skeletons turning up where the old school building was torn down.
So people said there'd been an air-raid shelter under it, or that lots of war dead were buried there...
All kinds of rumors went around.
And there's this story, too.
Lots of accidents happened while the old school building was being demolished.
People called it the curse of the skeletons, so they held a pretty large-scale purification rite.
Back then, I'd been assigned to write an article on the school's seven wonders.
At the time, I had a senior of mine, a guy named Hino, gather people who knew all about the school's seven wonders.
As I heard their stories, I learned lots of scary stories about this school, too.{p}

But in the end, that project turned into 'The Mystery of the Masses of Skeletons Found Under the Old School Building!'
Well, it couldn't be helped.
Something that really happened has more impact than mere rumors, after all.
You probably remember it too, don't you?
The police came, and it was even in the newspapers.
I was the one who wrote the school paper's article on it back then.
It was really well received.{p}

But I was disappointed.
Because that project got scrapped.
Even though it wasn't my project to begin with.
It was the club president's idea.
Still, for some reason, I was really disappointed.
Funny thing.
When that project was pushed onto me, I felt really bad about it.
If I could have, I wouldn't have done it.
That's how much I hated scary stories.
And yet look at me now.
I'm dying to do it, of my own free will.
So I thought about it.
When the second gym went up on the site of the old school building, this time I'd finally make this project happen.{p}

So, what do you say?
I'd like to entrust you with that important role.{p}How about it?
Will you do it?
I'll do it
Please, give me a break

"Heh, thank you..."
{a} patted me on the shoulder.
What strength.
"...Then I'll gather seven people who know all about the school's seven wonders. ...Let's see. The day after tomorrow would be good. Could you come to the club room again the day after tomorrow? I'll have it all arranged with the seven by then."
He's so pushy.
"Senpai, um..."{p}

Huh, what language was that?
"Oops, my mistake. See you, Taguchi. The day after tomorrow, I'm counting on you..."{p}

"Ah, Senpai!"
{a} left as if running away.{p}

Wait, what was that just now?
What on earth is {a}...?{p}

I'll skip it.
It's best to stay away from weirdos.
What should I do with the rest of today?
What should I do?
What should I do?
What should I do...?
"Taguchi.
You're late."{p}

Gah! {a}☆
"You never showed up no matter how long I waited, so I came to get you.
You're hopeless. Come on, let's hurry to the club room."
Ah, ah, aaaaaah.{p}

.........
Darn it.
I'm such an idiot.
I should have gone straight home.
"Huh, Taguchi. What are you pouting about?
...Could it be you had plans today?
Ha ha, sorry, sorry.
To make up for it, I'll show you something nice."
...Something nice?
What could it be?{p}

"These are photos I took the year before last..."
Oh...
"So pretty."
"Aren't they?{p}

...Look, how about this one?"
"Whoa.
Senpai, what's this photo?"
"A mirror that was in the old school building.
And a devil."
"...Wh-why do you have a photo like that?"
"I was going to run it in the school paper two years ago."
"Is it a doctored photo?"
...{a} is smirking.
Something's off about this.{p}

"There's lots more.
Look..."
"Did you take all of these, Senpai?"
"Yeah, a lot happened back then."{p}

"This is the old school building's staircase.
Did you know?
The old school building was torn down two years ago.
All sorts of supernatural phenomena happened there.
There were lots of scary stories about these stairs, too... Brings back memories.
The thirteen steps..."
Senpai is muttering to himself.{p}

"Is this the old school building too?"
"That's right.
It's falling to pieces, isn't it?"
It really is.
The walls and floors look ready to cave in.
"They're building the second gym right now, right?
It's going up where the old school building was torn down.
So, to celebrate it, I want to do a feature on the school's seven wonders..."
"...Uh-huh.
Senpai, can I look at these photos over here too?"{p}

...Yeah, go ahead.
Look at the photos all you like.
By the way, did you know, Taguchi?
When they tore down the old school building, they say lots of skeletons came out.
Human ones, of course.
So people said there'd been an air-raid shelter under it, or that lots of war dead were buried there...
All kinds of rumors went around.
And there's this story, too.
Lots of accidents happened while the old school building was being demolished.
People called it the curse of the skeletons, so they held a pretty large-scale purification rite.
Back then, I'd been assigned to write an article on the school's seven wonders.
At the time, I had a senior of mine, a guy named Hino, gather people who knew all about the school's seven wonders.
As I heard their stories, I learned lots of scary stories about this school, too.{p}

But in the end, that project turned into 'The Mystery of the Masses of Skeletons Found Under the Old School Building!'
Well, it couldn't be helped.
Something that really happened has more impact than mere rumors, after all.
You probably remember it too, don't you?
The police came, and it was even in the newspapers.
I was the one who wrote the school paper's article on it back then.
It was really well received.{p}

But I was disappointed.
Because that project got scrapped.
Even though it wasn't my project to begin with.
It was the club president's idea.
Still, for some reason, I was really disappointed.
Funny thing.
When that project was pushed onto me, I felt really bad about it.
If I could have, I wouldn't have done it.
That's how much I hated scary stories.
And yet look at me now.
I'm dying to do it, of my own free will.
So I thought about it.
When the second gym went up on the site of the old school building, this time I'd finally make this project happen.{p}

So, what do you say?
I'd like to entrust you with that important role.{p}How about it?
Will you do it?
I'll do it
I can't

"I see. Thank you..."
{a} is breaking into a smile.
He looks like he's fondly remembering something...
"What are you looking at?"
Oh, it's a photo.
What's this...?{p}

"No, you can't. This is a very precious photo..."
Oh, he put it away.
Senpai, who on earth are those people...?
"Taguchi. Come back to the club room the day after tomorrow.
I'll round up seven people who know all about the school's seven wonders..."
"...{a}."
"Well, let's head home.
I'm counting on you, the day after tomorrow."
"......"{p}

No.
You can't get away from this.
This project can't happen without you.
Got it?
You'd better come, no matter what.
Or else...{p}

"Eeeeeek!☆"
{a}...
Stop tickling meee!☆
"Ahahaha...☆"
N-no, stop!
What is this squirmy thing?
It feels like I'm being tickled by a mop of fuzzy strings...
"S-stop it, please!"
"Heh heh heh.
I'll let you off if you take on the seven wonders project........."
Ahahahaha...................................................{p}

Honestly, {a}!
Tickling people like that is just mean.
But what on earth was that fuzzy thing?
A foxtail, maybe?
It felt like some kind of feelers.
And I think I saw something like an ammonite, too...
No, I must have imagined it.
Still, he really is a weird guy.
Ugh, what am I going to do?
It looks like I'm being forced into the seven wonders project.
He says I have to do the interviews the day after tomorrow.
{a} was all breezy about it, saying he'd set everything up for me, but...
What a drag.{p}

What did you say?
That won't do.
This is an order from your senior.
You have to do the interviews.
I'll round up seven people who know all about the school's seven wonders.
Right, let's make it the day after tomorrow.
Come back to the club room the day after tomorrow, got it?
"......{a}."{p}

He's so pushy.
He must really want to get this project through.
What a pain...
......{p}

I think he's an interesting person.
Or, to put it another way...
Kind of lovely, I guess?
Apparently, when he was a first-year, he was a total scaredy-cat.
Isn't that cute?
Actually, he's been on my mind lately.
My eyes keep following {a} around.
Somehow I feel like I just can't leave him be.
You could say he tickles my maternal instinct.
Hee hee...{p}

I think he's a mysterious person.
Like, it seems nothing could ever faze him.
...Well, maybe things do faze him.
More like he bounces back fast.
Like he'd come back to life even if he died.
Oh, right, I hear that when {a} does Kokkuri-san, he uses a 500-yen coin.
That way, he can summon a genuine high-level spirit as Kokkuri-san.
Maybe I'll ask him to do it for me.
I'll bring a 500-yen coin with me.
Okay, I'd better get going, or I'll be late for our appointment.{p}

...The hallway seems kind of dim.
It isn't even that late.
Maybe it's because it's cloudy outside?
This school has its own creepy atmosphere, but on days like this I feel it even more strongly.
There are so many incidents and accidents here that nobody can explain.
And they say the second gym that's almost finished is being built right where a mountain of human bones turned up...
Still, was this hallway always this long?
I'm not getting anywhere at all.
...Huh?★
Someone's sitting on the floor over there.
It looks like a girl, but...{p}What should I do? Should I call out to her?
Call out to her
Ignore her

I decided to ignore her after all.
She just didn't seem like a normal person.
She was... how do I put it?
I feel like she was giving off something, a sinister aura, a ghostly aura, whatever you call it.
She must have been a ghost or something.{p}

...Phew, I finally made it to the stairs.
But why are the first-year classrooms on the top floor, anyway?
Every morning I'm nearly late, and I'm sick of it.
Late...!
Oh nooo, it's already past the time we agreed on.
I have to hurry.{p}

Ah, I can finally see the club room.
Standing in front of it... who's that girl?
I've never seen her before.
Someone who wants to join?
Or was she called here by Senpai, like me?
Oh, now that I look closer, she's not in uniform.
Huh, so she's not a student.
"Excuse me, you there?"
All of a sudden, she spoke to me.
"Y-yes?"
I answered without thinking.
I hate to admit it, but she's prettier than me.{p}

"Do you know someone named Shinji Kondo?"
Shinji Kondo...?
I've never heard that name before.
"No, I don't."
"I see. Where on earth could he be?
And he's my destined one..."
Saying that, the woman wandered unsteadily away.
Her destined one, huh? How romantic.
Hee hee, she even had a red thread wound around her little finger.
So even grown-ups believe in that stuff.{p}
I opened the door cheerfully.{p}
And all at once, fourteen eyes turned toward me.{p}

Seven people, boys and girls, are sitting around the big table in the middle of the club room.
They're all staring at me, looking startled.
Except for {a}, they're all complete strangers.
I was so sure Senpai would be the only one here...
"Um, you must be the seventh one.
Please, have a seat over here."
Geez, {a} is being so formal, acting like this is the first time we've ever met.
Anyway, what are these people doing here?
"Um, {a}-senpai.
What did you need me for?
And what do you mean, the seventh one...?"
"Huh? Um, 'senpai'...?"
{a} is looking at me with a puzzled frown.
Those are really the eyes of someone looking at a stranger.{p}

"Well, {a}, you're a sly one.
Going and getting yourself a cute girlfriend like this."{p}

"Did you hear that?
She called him 'senpai.'"{p}

"Which means she's his junior from middle school.
Let's have a look... Well, well, isn't she quite the cutie?
All right, as a special favor, I'll tell your fortune with Kokkuri-san.
Don't worry, the Kokkuri-san I summon is a high-level spirit."{p}
"That's so mean, {a}! Keeping it a secret even from me, your best friend!"{p}

"Hmm. So you're {a}'s girlfriend?
How unremarkable."{p}

"Hey, hey, where did you two meet?
How did you start going out?"{p}

The other six seem to have mistaken me for Senpai's girlfriend.
They're all teasing us at once.
"Everyone, hold on a minute!"
Senpai stood up from his seat and shouted the six of them down.{p}

So cool..........
I think I might fall for him.
"Hey, you."
"Y-yes!"
No, no, this is no time to be swooning.
"Sorry, but I think you've got the wrong person.
I am {a}, sure, but I don't know anyone like you. And besides, I'm still only a first-year. I can't think of any reason anyone would call me 'senpai.'"{p}

Whaaaaaaaaat?!★
That's impossible...
Now that I think about it, Senpai... does look a teeeeny bit younger...
Is this back when Senpai was a first-year?
Did I slip back in time or something?★
Eeek, how cool! It's just like a movie!{p}

But if I tell them that, will they even believe me?
Even if this is the past, it would make me sad to have {a} look at me like I'm weird.
"Could you be someone Hino knows?
Seeing as you're wearing the uniform, you seem to be a student here..."{p}Now what do I do?
How should I answer?
Say I came from the future
Just nod along

"Yes, yes, that's right, actually.
Um, I was told to come here... and to have a little fun with you all."{p}

Hee hee, looks like I fooled them nicely.
Still, I don't get this 'seventh one' business.
Seventh in what order?
"Well then, please tell us the last story.
Everyone's been waiting, so they won't be satisfied with just any ordinary scary story."
Scary story...?
Then this must be the seven wonders gathering I've heard rumors about.
So they really held one at this school, too.
And Senpai is involved in it...
He really is a mysterious person.
But is it really okay for me to be doing this?
Will I actually be able to get back to my own world?
With those thoughts in my head, I began to speak.
"Well then, this is something that happened to me just now..."{p}
And so began the seventh story, one that by rights should never have been told...{p}

Actually, I'm in love with him.
...You know, here's what I think.
In this world, there are people who rule and people who are ruled.
{a} is one of the people who rule.
And I don't mean he just looks that way because he's bossy.
{a} is the best.
He knows all kinds of stories.
Scary stories about our school.
And then there's his face when he tells those stories.
It's so mysterious, it just gets me.
Some people say that face scares them and they hate it.
But I don't care. I love him.
If it were Senpai, I'd love to be ruled.
...Just kidding.
But, gosh, I'm getting nervous.{p}

"Um, is something wrong?"
I called out to her.
Somehow I just can't ignore someone like that.
It looked like the girl had been crying.
When I spoke to her, she peered up at me through the gaps in the hands covering her face, two big, goggling eyes staring out.
And then,
"...Huh. Just a girl..."
She spat out just those words, then faded away without a sound.
W-what kind of attitude was that?!☆
I wasn't scared so much as furious.
The first ghost I've ever seen in my life, and it's like this? That really ticks me off.
That's it, I'm taking it out on {a}!{p}

Here I am at the newspaper club.
"Excuse meee!"{p}
Oops, I opened the door without even knocking.{p}

"No, that's not it. The truth is, I came from the future...!"
It's a really sudden thing to say, but I'm sure {a} will believe me.{p}"Uh-huh, uh-huh, and then?"
Oh, how mean! Senpai doesn't believe me one bit.
Insist I came from the future
Smooth it over somehow

"I really did come from the future, I'm telling you!"
"...I see. Then how about telling us a little about this future of yours?
Did a world war break out?
What about the ozone hole?
Have you ever traveled in space?"{p}

"In the time I come from, they're about to finish building the second gym.
There used to be an old school building there, right?
I heard that when they tore that old school building down, they found lots of human bones."
Everyone suddenly went quiet.
Looks like they finally believe me.
"...Okay, thank you very much.
With that, we have our seven stories, so I'd like to bring this meeting to a close."
Huh? That's it?{p}

Ahh, everyone's leaving.
"Um, it was Taguchi, right?
Thanks for your trouble. You can go home now."
With that, {a} left too.
